name: Apex Solventless | 1g Live Rosin Tier 1 | Moon Glow #23
description:
The Moonbow line of genetics is known for producing delectable crosses that taste like Original Z, gas, and candy and this creation does not dissapoint! Moon Glow is a cross of Planet Purple to Moonbow. The offspring produced have a very 'deep wine berry candy gas' flavor and aroma. The Planet Purple brings in the deeper wine berry flavors that accompany the candy gas of Moonbow so well. Moon Glow #23 packs the best of boths worlds into a new creation that is sure to impressed any rosin lover.

Cross: Planet Purple #144 x Moonbow IX #112

Terp Profile: Tropical, Candy, Gas
